subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should OpenClaw expose Google Chat DM thread sessions as the public `threadSessions` config key and add `parentPeer` to the public inbound-envelope SDK helper for this path?
rationale: The behavior is useful, but it creates public config and SDK contract surface that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive and not safe for automation to decide implicitly.

options.title: Accept Narrow Public Shape
options.body: Keep `threadSessions` and the `parentPeer` helper parameter, but require regenerated baselines, a rebase, and current-head Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Route Parent Private
options.body: Avoid expanding the public SDK helper and solve the Google Chat routing path through a channel-local or already-approved seam.

options.title: Consolidate With Related Thread Work
options.body: Pause this PR and settle one canonical Google Chat thread-session plan with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/68967 before accepting either option name or scope.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Public Shape
recommendation.body: Keep `threadSessions` and the `parentPeer` helper parameter, but require regenerated baselines, a rebase, and current-head Google Chat proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across routing, Plugin SDK public helpers, and Google Chat runtime changes.
